findings.notes: The cleanup controller built its context loader without the policy's own scope, so a namespaced CleanupPolicy's context entries were treated as cluster scoped and were not confined to the policy's namespace. The fix passes the real policy to the context loader factory, so a namespaced CleanupPolicy resolves apiCall and configMap context only within its own namespace, and rejects global references at both admission and runtime. Enterprise commits a873f7fa22 and 2516b33c57 on this branch.

A namespaced CleanupPolicy could issue apiCall context requests to paths outside its own namespace. The fix validates the apiCall path and confines it to the policy's namespace, rejecting cross-namespace and cluster-scoped requests before they are sent. Cluster-scoped CleanupPolicy behavior is unchanged. Enterprise commits a873f7fa22 and 2516b33c57 on this branch.
